text:
emma (release): quick sync — planning a gradual v2 rollout with session-affinity enabled for streaming routes in us-east-1 starting 22:00 UTC. will route 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 30m windows.
raj (infra): noted. prober config updated, will watch 5xx and tail latency. adding a short-circuit to divert traffic back to v1 on threshold.
mike (deploy): deploy queued. deploy-bot, please run the staged rollout plan with id: rollout-2026-06-21-01.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout rollout-2026-06-21-01 by mike. stages: [5%,20%,50%], region: us-east-1, feature: session_affinity=true. preflight checks passed.
sophie (client-sdk): heads up — client SDK sticky session behavior changed slightly when affinity is on. mobile SDK will send header X-Session-ID; we need to confirm header case normalization.
emma (release): good catch. raj — can we add a header-normalize shim at the edge for this rollout window? want to avoid mobile clients being pinned unexpectedly.
raj (infra): yes, can push a quick header-normalize filter on the edge as a safe peel. will do before the 22:00 start.
olivia (oncall): rollout guard: if 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m OR median p95 latency increases >200ms vs baseline, we rollback. also watch tail error types — auth failures and 429s could indicate client-side header mismatch. :rotating_light:
mike (deploy): documented rollback criteria in the runbook. mike: if we get trigger, do immediate 100% divert to v1 and then open an incident.
emma (release): also: release notes snippet ready, mention that v2 enables session affinity for streaming and that some older SDKs may need header update. will delay release-mses for any customers pinned to v1 if they flag.
sophie (client-sdk): quick test command for probe team: 
```
curl -H "X-Session-ID: abc123" -H "User-Agent: mobile-sdk/1.2.0" https://api.redwood.ai/v2/streaming/status
```
responds 200 + set-cookie when affinity active. if older UA without header, should still get v2 but non-affined.
raj (infra): prober config snippet applied: `prober:check.affinity=true`, sampling rate 10% on mobile UA. will post results into #observability.
deploy-bot: stage 1 (5%) started at 1764242460. health: ok. traffic shifted.
olivia (oncall): seeing a small uptick in 429s from one ISP, digging. not yet breaching rollback.
emma (release): do not escalate yet, mike — hold stage 2 for another 10m while we watch.
mike (deploy): pausing progression at 5%. manual continue pending olivia sign-off. :thumbsup:
olivia (oncall): ok sign-off to continue in 8m if 429s trend down.
raj (infra): added short-lived client-pin override to keep explicit tenants on v1 for the window. command: `rbctl pin tenant:acme corp -> v1 until 2026-06-22T04:00Z`
sophie (client-sdk): i'll ping a few key customers with SDK <1.3.0 to let them know header case might matter.
emma (release): final note — if we see auth errors spike >0.1%, rollback immediate. otherwise continue staged and capture eval prompts for quality telemetry. thanks team.
